usabilityFindings: New SKIP metadata badges remain separate from difficulty labels on kanji entries; no overlap observed in the 390px sheet.
Six shape-finder lenses form a four-plus-two grid with SKIP clearly selected.

320px shelf top controls stay single-line; long search placeholder truncates within its field and content doors wrap vertically.
